# A document that loads the index package with noautomatic

Two indexes are declared. The first is built by Quarto's own PDF loop; every
one after it is built by `imakeidx`, which runs the index tool itself — and
`noautomatic` is the package option that turns that run off, for every index at
once. This document loads `imakeidx` with it before the extension's own load
runs, so nothing the filter emits can reach that decision, and the second index
would print empty.

That is the one preamble collision this extension cannot repair, so it is made
loud instead: a begin-document check says what will be missing and why. It
warns rather than erroring, because a marked-up document must still render.

One term files in each: [Alpha]{.index} and
[Babbage]{.index index="authors"}.
